_meta.description: ILM for agent-insights-* (monthly index agent-insights-YYYY-MM; low-volume analytical/learning records feeding the pedagogical model). min_age-based delete from index creation (no rollover write-alias). Retention: 365d. Authored in FRE-543; the family had no lifecycle policy before and accreted indices forever. warm forcemerge min_age raised 7d->32d in FRE-1036 (bug fix, folded in while applying the same pattern elsewhere): a monthly index is still open at 7d, so the original setting forcemerged a still-written index; 32d matches the user-turn-ratings-policy precedent, which got this right at authoring time.
